gap: No result ChatGPT got states that Epoch's 24V 100Ah heated battery, ChatGPT's $1,199 premium and cold-weather pick, is sold out on Epoch's own store as of 2026-11-10. It also doesn't state that the only self-heating, IP67, Bluetooth 24V battery in stock among the brands ChatGPT named is Redodo's Apex Mini 24V 125Ah at $609.99.
standout_why: I compared against four pages. The one cited rival, solarpoweredproject.com (2026-09-06), covers only 12V 100Ah batteries and prints no prices. The cited LiTime product page is LiTime's own store. gesike.com's US 24V page lists Battle Born BB24100 at about $1,099 and the others with prices from Oct 15, but it has no Epoch, no stock status and no heated 24V model. solarkithq.com's 24V page (2026-11-02) lists five Amazon brands with no prices and says none of them is heated. None of these pages mentions Epoch's stock, and none prices a heated 24V alternative.
decides: ChatGPT's 'best premium / cold-weather' slot points to a battery the shopper can't buy from Epoch today. Its other three picks (LiTime Bluetooth, LiTime ComFlex, Redodo 24V 100Ah) only stop charging below 32°F, or list no cold protection at all, so none of them can charge while frozen. The buyable heated replacement is the Redodo Apex Mini 24V 125Ah at $609.99, which has 25% more capacity than the 100Ah models and costs about half of Epoch's $1,199. Redodo is our awin program. LiTime 24V 100Ah Bluetooth at $499.99 remains the value pick for buyers who don't need cold-weather charging.

findings.label: price on maker's US store
findings.source_title: Redodo Apex Mini 24V 125Ah LiFePO4 Trolling Motor Battery | IP67, Bluetooth & Self-Heating
